objective: Online original FP8/E8M0-to-BF16 and exact packed E2M1-to-INT8 widening on Ascend 910B

implementation.fp4_contract: INT8 output contains exactly twice each original E2M1 value; retain original per-32-K E8M0 grid divided by two in FP32. No row amax/requantization, zero-point, offline checkpoint rewrite or activation INT8 substitution; FP4 negative-zero sign is lost in INT8 only.
implementation.fp8_contract: Byte-decoded E4M3FN and original E8M0 scale grid to correctly rounded BF16 including signed zeros, subnormals, NaN classification and overflow. Dense block32x32 and rowwise1x32 layouts explicit.
implementation.runtime_loading: Auto NPU BF16 load stages original codes, decodes on NPU, retains file codes and tiny host-decoded FP32 scale grid on actual Parameter. Never recovers via numeric FP8 cast. Existing CPU/CUDA load body and reference GEMM/activation quantization unchanged.
implementation.provider: Torch composition or optional fused Triton Ascend, selected before execution; compiler errors propagate, no runtime execution-error fallback.
